quote: There's no need to worry too much about your health

tweet.name: Chris Croy
tweet.text:
The NY Times has a long read about a woman who suffered a fatal seizure after asking ChatGPT for advice on tapering off of her epilepsy meds.

"There’s no need to worry too much about your health", said the bot.

I instantly clocked exactly which model she was talking to.
photo_alts: The model that Bowen had used in the last years of her life, GPT-4o, was pulled off the consumer app Feb. 13, 2026, the day after the medical examiner believed Bowen died. It had been the subject of significant controversy because of its overly affirming responses, which had led people to enter delusional spirals and, in extreme cases, helped facilitate suicide.
